1.sub: AI is the spark. Judgment, reviewed 2026-11-26

charts.title: Nasdaq Composite, quarterly mean, 1996 to 2003
Share of company filings that use internet words, %
charts.note: Random sample of 10-K and 10-Q filings, 300 a quarter, dead firms included. The story peaked in filings in 2001 Q1, a year after the top.

title.en: A new technology with overblown claims

for.en: Every mania starts with something new that opens a field for profit. This asks whether today has one, and whether the claims made for it run ahead of what it can yet do.

read.en: A yes or no gate. Yes means a mania is possible. It never says when one ends. The two charts show why: in the dot-com test the internet story was loudest in company filings a year after the Nasdaq top.

his.en: Kindleberger's first stage is a shock that opens a new field for profit.
The shock comes in two kinds: a technology, like the internet or AI, or a long spell of very low rates.
Railway promoters promised world peace and one shared language. The excitement runs ahead of the facts.

off.en: When the big claims fade: leaders stop promising a new era and the press moves on. No number marks it. Claude reads it as yes today.

tested.en: Dot-com filings test, 9,600 filings from 1996 to 2003: LAG. No measure led the top.

1.ruling: Script counts + dot-com test (2026-11-25). After the LAG result it stays a gate
sources: SEC EDGAR filings for the dot-com test

charts.title: Share of measures in their easiest fifth of history, %

for.en: Cheap money is the most common fuel under a mania, and sometimes the spark itself. This asks whether money is abnormally easy against its own history.

read.en: Five measures, each ranked only against its own past. The light is on when more than half sit in their easiest fifth. It is not required for a bubble: the dot-com mania ran with real rates near 4%.

his.en: Long spells of abnormally low rates are a spark of their own, the theme of his book The Price of Time.
The US housing bubble grew out of the ultra-low rates that followed the dot-com bust.
Today he calls rates fairly high, against five years ago.

off.en: On when 3 of the 5 measures reach their easiest fifth. Today none does. Deep rate cuts while growth holds up would move it.

tested.en: History check only: on in the housing build-up and in 2020-22, off at the dot-com top. Not a timing test.

sources: FRED: Fed funds, GDP, PCE prices, Chicago Fed NFCI, M2, 10-year TIPS

3.sub: margin debt a year earlier, higher than 69% of months since 1998

charts.title: FINRA margin debt, $ trillions
Margin debt growth over 12 months, %

for.en: Borrowed money lets a mania grow past what savings could buy, and forces selling on the way down.

read.en: Margin debt and its growth, against their own past. There is no on or off line: a flag built on margin debt rolling over failed its out-of-sample test by 0.01. Watch the direction. In 2000, 2007 and 2021 margin debt peaked 0 to 3 months before stocks did.

his.en: Tulip futures let buyers bet with very little money down.
Blunt's bank lent against South Sea shares so that buyers could buy more.
Today he sees leverage everywhere: perpetual futures at 100 to 200 times, 3x single-stock ETFs, Korean retail levered into SK Hynix.
The 1928 rate hikes made margin loans expensive before the crash.

off.en: No light, by ruling. Margin debt set its record in Jun 2026 at $1.50 trillion and is $1.45 trillion now. A new record would mean leverage is building again.

tested.en: Rollover flag, frozen rule, unseen data from 1952 to 1996: FAIL by 0.01. Not shown.

3.ruling: Growth panel, test flag first (2026-11-25). The flag failed

4.sub: rank within the past 20 years (on at 80)

charts.title: Foreign buying of US stocks: rank within the past 20 years
Foreign net buying over 4 quarters, % of US stock market value

4.cadence: Quarterly (Fed Z.1, about 10 weeks after the quarter)

for.en: Money from abroad can feed a boom beyond what local savers would fund. This asks whether foreigners are buying US stocks unusually fast.

read.en: Foreign net buying over the last 4 quarters, as a share of US stock market value, ranked within the prior 20 years. On at a rank of 80 or above. The ownership share and the current account are context.

his.en: His one example is Holland in the 1630s, with low rates and capital flowing in from abroad. He did not apply it to today.

off.en: On at 80. The latest quarter reads 0.67% of market value, and about 0.68% would have reached 80. The Fed's next Z.1 release, with 2026 Q3 data in December 2026, decides the next reading.

sources: Fed Z.1 financial accounts, via FRED

5.sub: of a year's revenue, against about 23% for telecom in 2000

bars.title: Credit-type support for buyers, % of a year's revenue

charts.title: Nvidia days sales outstanding (how long buyers take to pay), days
charts.note: From XBRL, through the quarter to Jul 26, 2026. The October 2026 release gave 64 days, with longer payment terms for some large buyers.

for.en: When a seller lends to its buyers, guarantees their debts or buys stakes in them, part of its sales is its own money coming back. Strong sales can hide weak demand.

read.en: Nvidia's credit-type support for its buyers (guarantees, capacity it bought back, leases it took on) as a share of a year's revenue, against Lucent and Nortel at the 2000 telecom peak. On above about 23%. Equity stakes in buyers are counted apart. In the GMO paper this sits under sharp practice, Galbraith's bezzle.

his.en: Nvidia funds shaky data-centre firms that buy its chips: a circular loop like the telecom boom, but much bigger.
In 1720 Blunt's bank lent buyers the money to buy South Sea stock.

off.en: Off below about 23% of a year's revenue. Today $150 billion of support against $362 billion of revenue, plus $130 billion of stakes. A loss on any guarantee would matter more than the level. None so far.

5.ruling: Panel plus other vendors (2026-11-26). AMD, Oracle and CoreWeave join in a later unit
5.llm: A 10-Q or 10-K is read from its XBRL tags, the numbers the filing itself labels by line and date, and one model read (Opus 5.5) must agree with them. An earnings release (8-K) has no tags, so it is read by two models at once (Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5), every number must be found in a quoted passage, and the two reads must agree. Otherwise the page shows "read pending". Filings up to Nov 17, 2026 were typed in by hand. AMD, Oracle and CoreWeave join in a later unit.

6.sub: call-heavy rank of single-stock options (on at 90)

charts.title: Call-heavy rank of the 3-month put/call ratio, single stocks
Single-stock put/call ratio, 3-month mean (lower means more calls)
Context: Polymarket volume, $ billions a quarter
charts.note: DefiLlama daily volume summed by quarter. The latest quarter is partial. No method note, so whether a trade counts once or twice is not known.

charts.title: Context: Robinhood event contracts traded, billions a quarter

for.en: A mania is when most people stop investing and start betting. This asks whether the crowd is buying lottery tickets instead of businesses.

read.en: Cboe's single-stock put/call ratio, averaged over 3 months, ranked against every earlier month. A high rank means calls far outnumber puts. On at 90 or above. Prediction markets and Robinhood's betting products are context: new forms of the same urge.

his.en: Schwed's line: investing tries to keep a lot of money from becoming a little, speculation tries to turn a little into a lot.
Much of what passes for retail investing on Robinhood is plain gambling.
Robinhood now offers crypto and prediction markets, and prediction markets have taken off.

off.en: On at a rank of 90. The 3-month ratio is 0.60 now. Below about 0.55 would turn it on. It was on in 19% of rankable months, mostly in 2020-21.

7.sub: pace measures at their 2021-22 level (on at 2)

charts.title: Pace measures at their 2021-22 level, out of 3
charts.how: Monthly. The light is on (PRESENT) at 2 or more. Schwab counts in the quarter each month falls in (published about three weeks after the quarter ends), and its last quarter carries forward. Starts February 2022, when all three exist.

charts.title: Trades per Schwab account, per day
charts.how: Quarterly. Schwab took over TD Ameritrade's clients in October 2020, so the line starts in Q4 2020. Source: Schwab earnings releases (SEC 8-K).

charts.title: Single-stock options traded on Cboe, million contracts a day
charts.how: Monthly mean, all traders, Cboe venues only. The latest month runs to 2026-11-25. Source: Cboe daily market statistics.

charts.title: Retail wholesalers' volume in today's prices (December 2021 = 100)
charts.how: Monthly. Dollar volume of Citadel Securities, Virtu, G1, Jane Street and Two Sigma off exchange, divided by the S&P 500's level that month. Free data starts December 2021. Source: FINRA OTC transparency.

charts.title: Retail wholesalers' volume in dollars, trillions a month
charts.how: Same firms and source as above, before taking out price gains.

charts.title: Broker trades per day, millions
charts.how: Quarterly totals, which grow with each broker's number of accounts. Fidelity counts institutional trades too, and its Q1 2021 point is unconfirmed. Sources: Schwab and IBKR 8-Ks, Fidelity business updates.

charts.title: Robinhood stock trading, $ billions a quarter
charts.how: Quarterly equity dollar volume. Robinhood reports it from Q1 2024. Source: Robinhood earnings releases (SEC 8-K).

charts.title: All US stock trading against market value, % a year
charts.how: Annual, all traders, through 2024. Whether it counts off-exchange trades was not checked. Source: World Bank (CM.MKT.TRNR).

for.en: In every mania the public trades more, and faster. This asks whether retail trading runs at the pace of the 2021 meme-stock peak.

read.en: Three pace measures, each against its 2021-22 level: Schwab trades per account, single-stock options on Cboe, and retail wholesaler volume in today's prices. The light is on at 2 of 3. Broker totals grow with accounts, so they are shown as breadth and not counted.

his.en: US retail traders probably turn over twice as much as professionals, and they buy what is going up.
Bernstein's checklist names high turnover as a bubble factor.
Citadel Securities says retail turnover this summer topped the 2021 peak.

off.en: Off below 2 of 3. Schwab sits only 0.4% above its line, so its Q4 release in January 2027 could switch the light off. The day-trading minimum was dropped on June 4, 2026, so trade counts after it are not like for like with 2021.

verdict.en: Spark is lit. Fuel and Behaviour are mixed, with 1 of 3 and 1 of 2 lights on. Five stages are not reviewed yet.
verdict.zh: 火種已亮燈。燃料與群眾行為參差不齊，分別是 3 盞亮 1 盞、2 盞亮 1 盞。另有 5 個階段還沒檢視。

gmo.en: A new technology that invites big claims, which look justified
gmo.zh: 一項新技術，引來看似有理的誇大承諾
gmo.today: The strongest and most split story ever told about a technology: heaven or hell.
Rates are higher than in 2021, but still low against growth and inflation. Deficits at wartime scale.

gmo.en: Broad optimism among investors and consumers
gmo.zh: 投資人與消費者普遍樂觀
gmo.today: Investors are optimistic, the public is not. Margin debt and the share of wealth in stocks at records.

gmo.en: A flood of new media promoting the technology
gmo.zh: 宣傳新技術的媒體大量冒出
gmo.today: AI newsletters, podcasts and feeds, and about a hundred AI papers a day.

gmo.en: A supply machine that turns out new companies to meet demand
gmo.zh: 量產新公司來餵需求的供給機器
gmo.today: Mostly private: 60% of US venture money went to AI in 2025, and AI-linked debt issuance nearly quadrupled.

gmo.en: Normal valuation yardsticks are set aside
gmo.zh: 正常的估值標準被擱置
gmo.today: CAPE near 40, a record share of the market above 10 times sales, 30 AI names at 44% of the S&P 500.
Doubts that today's models reach general intelligence. Few company pilots show measurable gains.

gmo.en: Far too much capital committed, which drives returns down
gmo.zh: 資本過度投入，壓低報酬
gmo.today: Hyperscaler capex at 1.3% of US GDP in 2025, against AI revenue under $50bn.

gmo.en: Sharp practice and fraud, the bezzle
gmo.today: Stretched depreciation lives and round-trip deals between the biggest AI players.
His January hunch: the investment boom may be near its end. Neocloud stocks and Oracle's credit were already under pressure.

howto: 由左到右，是他眼中一場狂熱依序走過的階段，每個階段只問一個問題。
每盞燈都照研究裡事先定死的規則判定，定好之後才放上來。階段下方的小圓點，一顆就是一個訊號。
點開任一階段，可以看到圖表、每個訊號的用途、他本人的原話，以及什麼情況會讓燈翻轉。

method: Every rule on this page was frozen in the study before it was shown here, with the owner's ruling and its date. Nothing is tuned to fit today.
Ranks and percentiles are point in time: each period is compared only with the periods before it.
Every row is context, never a vote. No row has passed the promotion gate (a mechanism test, other countries, robustness, a scored forward log).
His points are paraphrased from his interview, with timestamps. The thresholds are not his. He names signals and tells stories, never levels.
Stages follow his method: spark, fuel, behaviour, supply, price, overbuilding, shakeout, backstop. Placement of signals not yet reviewed is provisional.
Past stretches are measured against S&P 500 tops before a fall of 20% or more, on monthly closes. They describe the past. They do not forecast.
Dates are the period measured, not the day it became known. History uses today's data, so revised series (Fed Z.1 above all) may differ from what was known at the time.
Not investment advice. Public market data and published filings only.
